svg.title: Collector DuckDB schema version 2
svg.desc: All 14 collector tables, 3 views and their column types. Solid arrows denote logical references, dashed arrows denote view dependencies. No foreign key constraints are declared. Shared provenance columns are shown in the COMMON panel.

text.tspan: 14 tables / 3 views | All stored fields shown; repeated COMMON columns are factored out.
Applied to all 12 tables marked + COMMON.
record_id is the declared primary key.
May be reused across multiple runs.
One option snapshot per sampled cycle.
raw_record_id uses the option quote payload.
Broker Greeks; not a model approval.
Repeats retained; sequence is per run.
Missed cycles have no sample rows.
Reference versions, not a symbol primary key.
VIEW | runs + counts by run_id from:
Logical polymorphic link, not a declared FK.
Solid blue arrows: referencing row -> referenced record (logical join).
Dashed purple arrows: view -> source table (dependency, not a foreign key).
PK marks declared primary keys. No FOREIGN KEY constraints are declared.
Other fields are nullable in the DDL; do not infer mandatory relationships.
Join raw payloads by record_id, not run_id: payloads can be shared across runs.
Symbol joins to instruments are logical and must account for effective versions.
cycles, diagnostics and requests have NULL raw_record_id.
TIMESTAMPTZ values are handled in UTC; feed numbers are unscaled.
Schema 1 upgrades to 2; complete received-update history starts with schema 2.
Slate | Shared columns and relationship notes
Amber | Run, schema and operational metadata
Teal | Raw payloads and received updates
Sky | Sampling cycles and option snapshots
